name: OpenFlowKit
tagline: The open-source local-first AI diagramming studio
description: OpenFlowKit is a free, open-source, local-first AI diagramming studio. You can create flows from templates, code, structured imports, or AI; refine them visually; keep everything local-first; and export cinematic MP4 walkthroughs. It can also be driven entirely from Claude, Cursor, or Windsurf through a first-party MCP server, with 1,600+ icons and full Mermaid support.
highlights: AI generation from 10 providers, including local Ollama for offline diagramming
Cinematic MP4 export via WebCodecs, faster than realtime
Bidirectional diagram-as-code sync with a git-friendly DSL
First-party MCP server to drive everything from agent IDEs
curatorNote: Actively pushed through the window and still underrated — a compelling local-first alternative to paid diagramming tools.
